# SiriusPoint and Sutton Special Risk announce new partnership and launch of SportsSecure™


-


09/28/26


SiriusPoint has today announced a new strategic partnership with Sutton Special Risk. Together, they have launched SportsSecure™, a specialized insurance solution designed to help college and university athletic programs manage injury-related financial exposures associated with Name, Image, Likeness (NIL) and revenue-sharing commitments.


[Click here](https://investors.siriuspt.com/press-releases/news-details/2026/SiriusPoint-and-Sutton-Special-Risk-announce-new-partnership-and-launch-of-SportsSecure/default.aspx) to read our press release in full on the Investor Relations website.


Written by SiriusPoint
